marta.name: Marta Voss, the Warden
marta.read: a plain iron kettle helm, shoulders like a door under a hide, a short quilted jack, a halberd stood upright with her lamp low on it

jory.name: Jory Pell, the Poacher
jory.read: a deep hood lined in red, a heavy olive coat, a pack with jaw traps swinging off it, a windlass crossbow held into his shoulder

agnes.name: Agnes Thorn, the Lamplighter
agnes.read: a flat cap and a soot-black smock, a ladder standing up over her back, a long pole with its wick burning at the far end

brask.name: Old Brask, the Dog Handler
brask.read: a barrel of a man under a ragged wolf pelt, bald, a beard like a spade, a boar spear stood upright, a hound at his knee

greta.name: Greta Hale, the Smith
greta.read: shoulders wider than a door, bare scorched arms, a leather apron to her knees, a red kerchief, tongs at her hip and a forge sledge on her shoulder with one face still red-hot

ned.name: Ned Rook, the Miner
ned.read: bent and long in the arm, a coat grey with stone dust, a leather hard hat with a candle stood on it, a powder keg on his back, a pick held ready

ida.name: Ida Marsh, the Ferrywoman
ida.read: a long wet oilskin and a sou'wester with its brim down her back, waders, a coil of rope, and a ferry pole three times her height with a lantern on its hook

silas.name: Silas Grey, the Butcher
silas.read: big and bald on no neck, a stained smock and apron with red strings, a cleaver like a tombstone held up, a meat hook swinging on a chain from the other fist

amos.name: Old Amos, the Drover
amos.read: a broad low hat over all his face but a white-whiskered jaw, a long frieze coat with a short cape, a red cloth at his throat, a cattle bell at his hip and a coil of rope at his back, a dog whistle on a cord, and a goad-spear taller than he is with an iron point and a hook

bull.name: Bull, the mastiff
bull.read: a great square-headed mastiff with heavy jowls and a pale chest, in a studded leather coat strapped under him and a collar of iron spikes

sexton.name: The Gravedigger
sexton.read: a back like a barrow with candles and their wax run down it, a tiny hooded head, a pointed grave spade the size of a door, an arm that drags a great bell, a red cage on his chest

risen.name: One of the risen
risen.read: a corpse bent double in a torn shroud, both arms reaching, its head hanging, grave earth on it

king.name: The Antlered King
king.read: a pale starved beast, all shoulder, with a dead tree of frosted antlers in which a lamp, a bell and a crow hang, an iron crown in his brow, broken spears and a red wound in his shoulder

herdbeast.name: One of the herd
herdbeast.read: a hart with nothing on it but hide and frost, head down, running

spinner.name: The Spinner
spinner.read: a spindle as tall as a man wound round with grey thread on eight long legs, a small veiled head with two hooked fangs, egg sacs hung under her, a line up into the dark, and a red place where the thread has worn through

spiderling.name: One of her young
spiderling.read: a little wound spindle on thin legs, veiled, with a fang

eggsac.name: An egg sac
eggsac.read: a pale veined sac as big as a calf in a nest of thread, dark shapes curled inside it

abbot.name: The Bell Abbot
abbot.read: a giant in a sodden habit hung with weed, a green bronze bell worn over his head to the shoulders and cracked down its front with red through the crack, the bell's iron clapper on a pole, his beads and a wooden cross

monk.name: One of his monks
monk.read: a drowned monk in a deep hood with nothing under it, walking with a tall candle on a staff

furnace.name: The Furnace
furnace.read: a round iron stove on two iron legs, a leaning chimney smoking, a band of glowing vents, a barred firebox door low and off to the side, a ladle of slag for one arm and a hooked poker for the other, a seam split red-hot

cinder.name: A cinder
cinder.read: a lump of clinker on two stubs, glowing through its cracks, sparks off it

barrel.name: A water barrel
barrel.read: a hooped barrel on its end, wet down its sides, water at its brim and a dipper in it

mirror.name: The Mirror King
mirror.read: tall and narrow in a king's robe gone to rags, a fur collar, a head that is one cracked pane of mirror under a crown of glass spikes, a chest of mirror with a red pane at its heart, a long splinter of mirror for a sword

reflection.name: A reflection
reflection.read: the Mirror King again in the pale of the glass, with no red in him, a little see-through

mirror-stand.name: A tall mirror
mirror-stand.read: a long mirror in a carved frame on clawed iron feet, a pale band of light across its glass

pikeman.name: Pikeman of the lodge
pikeman.read: a quilted coat with a red tabard, a mail hood under an iron cap, a pike held low

crossbowman.name: Crossbowman of the lodge
crossbowman.read: a great shield with a red stripe on his back, a padded cap, a crossbow at his shoulder

sapper.name: Sapper of the lodge
sapper.read: bent under a keg carried in both arms, a hide hood, a pick on his back, a lit match in his teeth

hound.name: Hound
hound.read: deep chest and thin loin, a heavy brow, an open jaw, a red rag at its collar

ballista.name: Ballista
ballista.read: a great crossbow tipped up on a sled, a bolt as long as a man

watchfire.name: Watchfire
watchfire.read: an iron basket on three legs with the fire in it

barricade.name: Barricade
barricade.read: sharpened stakes lashed across a log

bellpost.name: Bell post
bellpost.read: a timber post and arm with a bell hung from it and a rope to ring it by

streetlamp.name: Street lamp
streetlamp.read: a short iron post with a lit square lantern, stood down by the Lamplighter

villager-farmer.name: A farmer
villager-farmer.read: a straw hat with a torn brim, a pale smock, a sack over his shoulder he will not let go of, clogs; small and round-shouldered

villager-crone.name: An old woman
villager-crone.read: bent nearly double over a stick, a black shawl over her head and back, a long rust skirt, a basket with a loaf in it

villager-boy.name: A boy
villager-boy.read: small and barefoot, a cap too big for him, a green tunic tied with red, a stick for driving geese

cart.name: A cart
cart.read: a hand cart on two big spoked wheels, a cask and sacks under a red sheet roped down, two long shafts

sellsword.name: Sellsword
sellsword.read: a dented iron cap with a nose guard, mail over a stained gambeson, a short sword and a round shield with its paint gone; nothing of the lodge on him

bowman.name: Bowman
bowman.read: a short green hood with a long tail, a leather jerkin, a longbow as tall as he is, a bag of arrows at his hip

gravemarker.name: A grave marker
gravemarker.read: a crooked wooden cross on a mound of turned earth, a rag on its arm and a candle at its foot

totem.name: An antler totem
totem.read: a stake with bleached antlers lashed to its top, a red rag, bones and a little bell hung from it

stone.name: A standing stone
stone.read: a grey stone taller than a man, leaning, lichen on it and an old mark cut in its face

jawtrap.name: A jaw trap
jawtrap.read: an iron trap set open on the ground, its teeth up, its chain pegged out
